methods.label: Equal groups
methods.explanation: The product \(3\times 2\) means 3 equal groups of 2. Their total is \(2+2+2=6\), so \(3\times 2=6\).
methods.levelReason: Interpreting multiplication as equal groups uses Grade 2 knowledge, supported by elementary successive addition.
